framework.title: Location
framework.details:
Middle of the range = no trade.
Only meaningful areas identified in advance: a key level, a higher-timeframe level, a range high or low, a previous high or low.

framework.title: Permission
framework.details:
Touching a level is not permission.
Wait for real confirmation: a sweep and reclaim, displacement, a clear rejection, a break and retest.

framework.title: Invalidation
framework.details:
No clear invalidation = no trade.
Know where the idea is wrong before entering.

framework.title: Execution
framework.details:
Size from the invalidation and the risk limit.
Never choose size first and force the stop to fit.

checklist.title: Prepared levels
checklist.details: Context levels were updated and the important locations marked before trading.

checklist.title: Waited for location
checklist.details: No chasing and no intentional entry from the middle of a range.

checklist.title: Required permission
checklist.details: Every entry had genuine price-action confirmation.

checklist.title: Defined invalidation
checklist.details: Every trade had a structural invalidation level before entry.

checklist.title: Sized from risk
checklist.details: Size came from the invalidation distance, inside the thesis risk limit.

checklist.title: Handled losses correctly
checklist.details: After a failed thesis: flat, orders canceled, the reset taken, context rebuilt, no revenge trade.

checklist.title: Respected daily limits
checklist.details: Entry, failed-thesis, risk and daily-loss limits respected. No widened stop, no averaging into a loser.

checklist.title: Stopped appropriately
checklist.details: Stopped when conditions no longer justified trading, a hard limit was reached or the ceiling applied. No extra trade to reach a target.

violations.title: More entries than the daily limit
More failed theses than the daily limit
Intentionally traded from the middle of a range
Increased size from frustration or a loss
Came back for nighttime recovery trading

steps: Positions are flat
Working orders are canceled
Zoom out to the 15-minute chart
Reassess the 5-minute structure
Identify the current range
Name what is genuinely new
